resolutions.researcher_notes: Petro-News company-directory profile of Petroleum Pipelines Company (PPC) states the company has operated 'منـذ عـام 1955 من خلال خط السويس / مسطرد قطر 12 بوصة بطول 134 كم' (since 1955 via the Suez/Musturad line, 12in, 134km) and describes PPC's core business as 'نقل المنتجات النفطية بدءاً من آبار الخام إلى مصافي التكرير' (moving crude from wellheads to refineries) -- supports Fuel=Oil for this crude trunk line. Live URL confirmed (almalnews.com, the other listed current_ref, is a genuine 404 with no Wayback capture -- dead, no replacement found there). Single source -> medium.

Same Petro-News profile describes the Suez/Musturad line as the pipeline PPC has run continuously since 1955, i.e. an ongoing, currently-operating line -- supports Status=operating. The original almalnews.com ref is confirmed dead (HTTP 404, no Wayback snapshot available), so this is a genuine DEAD_LINK situation resolved by a new source rather than a reverification. Single source -> medium.
